noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

name.description:
The name to use for the tag and/or property when serializing this field
For array fields, each element has this name

hidden.description: Do not serialize fields with hidden = true

txtContent.description:
if true, serialize / deserialize field value to / from the text content between tags
E.g.:
To parse the following xml, where the <Name> tag is corresponding to a field of TypeRef, to load its value to a
field in the type 'NameStructure', the '@xmlField(txtContent = true)' annotation needs to be added on that field
in definition :

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<SF86>
<IdentifyingInformation >
  <Name>Jonathan</Name>
</IdentifyingInformation>
</SF86>

The c3Type definition should be:
type IdentifyingInformationStructure {Name : NameStructure }

type NameStructure {
  @xmlField(txtContent = true)
  xmlElementTextContent: string
}

title: Specifies how fields are to be serialized as xml
name: Ann.XmlField
